name: Gondanglegi

queries.query: Gondanglegi Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN land office Malang
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS platforms as the national public land-spatial viewer and found the official Dinas Pertanahan Kabupaten Malang portal and Kecamatan Gondanglegi portal. BHUMI documentation describes public parcel layers and parcel search by NIB, HAK, or NIBEL. No anonymous Gondanglegi ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.

queries.query: peta bidang tanah kadaster resmi Kecamatan Gondanglegi Kabupaten Malang ATR BPN layanan geospasial
queries.result: Indonesian-language first-party discovery confirmed Gondanglegi as an official Kecamatan Kabupaten Malang and found the Malang local geospatial portal LokaGeo, which advertises a 1:5000 base-map WebGIS and SHP/GeoJSON catalog. The inspected WebGIS used OpenStreetMap and exposed no cadastral WMS/WFS/ArcGIS/GeoJSON service or native parcel identity. No anonymous parcel feature response was qualified.

registryCustodian.name: ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS; local Malang land administration context not independently qualified
registryCustodian.scope: ATR/BPN is the evidenced national land-spatial publication platform. The official Malang local portals evidence land/planning and geospatial activity, but do not establish an accessible local cadastral registry or anonymous parcel service for Gondanglegi.
